edits.say: Pull the white rectangular cover straight forward off the wall base. Use the straight screwdriver to loosen the thermostat body and lift it off so the tan wiring board shows. Photograph the board with the red and white wires on your phone.

why: 0:22 the cover comes off; 0:24-0:26 she works a black straight screwdriver on the thermostat body before the tan board is exposed; 0:28-0:32 phone photo of the red/white wires (on-screen tip: let house members know the power is going off).
0:34-0:38 straight screwdriver loosens the silver terminal screws holding the red and white wires; 0:40-0:46 only the wall hole with the red and white wires remains.
0:48-0:50 base held over the hole with wires through the centre; 0:52-0:56 top screw driven with the white-handled screwdriver, blue level bubble at top; 0:58-1:00 bottom screw.

placements: red insulated wire with about 3/8-inch bare copper end → into the gray Rc push-tab, the bottom tab on the left side of the white circular base (below the O/B tab), pressed with fingertip and pushed straight in until seated

white insulated wire with about 3/8-inch bare copper end → into the gray W1 push-tab, the top tab on the right side of the white circular base (above the W2 AUX tab), pressed with fingertip and pushed straight in until seated

why: Left column reads Y1, Y2, G, O/B, Rc top to bottom (0:58, 1:00), so Rc sits below O/B, not directly below G; 1:06-1:08 red goes into Rc, 1:14-1:16 white into W1 above W2/AUX.
1:20-1:24 'Step 5 Attach display panel': she tucks the wires and presses the round display onto the base; step 6 title at 1:26.

edits.safety: Touch only the breaker handle when you switch the power back on, and tell everyone at home it's back on.

why: 1:26-1:32 phone app setup with on-screen tip 'let house members know the power is back on'; 1:34 display lit orange HEATING. The 'keep hands dry and stand clear' line overstates the breaker flip; the video's own tip is about telling house members.
